mostWorthwhile.text: Following ADH to the kidney was most worthwhile: it connected a bloodborne signal to water returning to the blood and less water remaining in urine.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the hormone route to the body felt least engaging because it repeated the connection without much new explanation.

surprise.text: The separate nerve-ending and blood-vessel combination clarified how ADH reaches the blood after the earlier result had moved quickly from sensing to release.

arbitrary.text: The later construction of the hormone route felt slightly out of order because ADH had already been released and acted on the kidney. Its purpose became clearer from the explanation.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the body systems interact, although the mostly single-option sequence made this chapter feel more like following an explanation than making meaningful choices.
